literature_source: Pending: client peptide list and supporting literature not yet received.
notes: Computational study on the existing platform; no model or pipeline changes. Goal: a novel, diverse, lab-testable shortlist of 20-30 peptides that dampen excessive inflammation and steer the immune response toward repair. Target signals: cytokine suppression (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta), M1-to-M2 macrophage polarization, NO suppression, ROS/antioxidant activity, NF-kB inhibition. Guardrail: avoid broad immunosuppression so infection defense is preserved, hence no pathogen targets and no antimicrobial requirement. Length range 8-30 and the <60% identity novelty threshold are proposed defaults, to be agreed. Success criteria: known reference peptides outscore decoys (sanity check); shortlist spans multiple sequence clusters; every candidate passes all hard filters with a stated rationale. Label every output: 'Computational / de novo candidate. Predicted, not experimentally validated.'
